calendar.matters:
AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-16-2015 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Charles Crompton, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, Proceedings reported by: Paula Shi, CSR#13358.
Petitioner Dior Hall mother of minor present in court.
Petitioner sworn and examined.
Proof of Publication on file.
Order granting Petitioner's request to Change Name of Minor without further notice to other parent on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Kiyoshi Oscar Antonio to Kiyoshi Oscar Hall.
Decree Changing Name signed in open court.
